claims: Real estate is land and the buildings on it, along with natural resources like water or minerals.
Real Brokerage is a publicly traded, cloud-based real estate brokerage.
The RealReal is an online marketplace for authenticated luxury resale goods.
RealTrends is a source for analysis and verification of real estate professionals.
Real Madrid CF is a Spanish professional football (soccer) club.
"Real" is used in the names of several clubs, such as Real Sociedad or Real Betis.
Real numbers are a set of numbers that include all rational and irrational numbers.
In economics, real value/terms are values adjusted for inflation to represent purchasing power, rather than nominal (face) value.
Brazilian Real is the currency of Brazil.
The plural of Brazilian Real is reais.
Real is a Japanese manga series written by Takehiko Inoue
